title: IND vs NZ 2nd T20I: New Zealand reach 66 runs in 10 overs against Team India
text:
IND vs NZ 2nd T20I: New Zealand reach 66 runs in 10 overs against Team India 
 Home / Sports / Cricket / Article / IND vs NZ 2nd T20I: Team India's bowlers strike early wickets; New Zealand reach 66 runs in 10 overs 
 IND vs NZ 2nd T20I: Team India's bowlers strike early wickets; New Zealand reach 66 runs in 10 overs
 Updated On: 24 October, 2026 01:24 PM IST | Mumbai | mid-day online correspondent 
 Team India's Bhuvneshwar Kumar, Arshdeep Singh, and Prince Yadav have bagged one wicket each. Naman Dhir, Axar Patel, and Nitish Kumar Reddy are yet to claim any wickets
 Listen to this article : Team India's players celebrate a wicket during the second T20I match against New Zealand (Pic: X/@BCCI)
 In the second T20I match against Team India , New Zealand has reached the score of 66 runs for the loss of three wickets in 10 overs at the Hagley Park South in the central city of Christchurch.
 Having been put to bat first, New Zealand's wicketkeeper-batsman Tim Seifert scored seven runs in six balls, including a maximum. Fellow opening batsman Fin Allen smashed 16 runs in 14 balls, including a maximum.
